_about: Live corpus for the scrape-quality signal (apps/api/src/lib/quality.ts). Each row is bucketed by what it demonstrates, not just 'good/bad'. 'expect' is the behavior we want to observe: a grade ('A'), a finding code ('JS_SHELL', ...), or 'ERROR' (a loud hard-block — the contrast that defines the silent-200 scope). Issue numbers point at the documented customer pain points each bucket maps to. Sites drift; this is best-effort and the deterministic gate is quality.test.ts.

_buckets.engine_delta: client-rendered: plain fetch silently returns a 200 with a near-empty shell; forcing the browser engine recovers the content. Run with --engines to see the flip / content recovery.
_buckets.silent_200: fetch returns a 200 the signal grades F; here the browser alone doesn't fix it (needs auth or a stealth proxy) — the signal flags it either way.
_buckets.hard_block: anti-bot responds with a loud 5xx — the engine errors, quality() never runs. OUT of scope by design; included as the contrast to a SILENT 200.
_buckets.charset: non-Latin pages. The pipeline decodes charset correctly today → grade A. GARBLED is the regression guard, and correctly does NOT fire here.
_buckets.boilerplate: real homepages with heavy nav/cookie/footer chrome. HIGH_BOILERPLATE stays conservative — full homepages are not flagged (no false positives).
_buckets.control: clean, server-rendered content. Must grade A — the false-positive floor at scale.

corpus.note: pure client-rendered SPA — empty #root on fetch, toolbar/menu text after render. The clean grade flip.
purpose-built JS-rendering test page; fetch sees ~no quotes, browser renders all of them (content recovery, grade stays A — a calibration point).
SPA calculator — small static shell on fetch, ~10x more UI text after render.
Vue SPA — mild content recovery with a browser.
React SPA reference app — empty-ish shell, hydrates client-side.
draw.io SPA — candidate; the grid decides whether it flips.
200 + JS shell on fetch; the browser hits the same JS/auth wall — needs the x-twitter engine. Signal flags it either way.
Monaco SPA — empty shell, no text even with a browser without interaction.
anti-bot 5xx — loud failure, not a silent 200.
anti-bot hard-block (#2413 — a charged scrape that returned nothing usable).
Japanese news — charset decoded correctly; GARBLED correctly silent.
university homepage — heavy nav/footer, still real content -> not flagged.
mall directory — chrome-heavy but not flagged.
docs page — the canonical clean A.
article ABOUT Cloudflare — must NOT trip SOFT_BOT_WALL.
regression: a 404 here once falsely tripped SOFT_BOT_WALL on the 'cloudflare' image URL. Must stay clean.
article ABOUT CAPTCHAs — another SOFT_BOT_WALL false-positive guard.
